value.rationale: The 2026 pair-generation profile is designed to quantify which functions can remain separated under cyclic pair access and data protection. The standard lexicographic affine truth-table Reed–Muller family is a canonical infinite evaluation-code family. Complete all-threshold ranks determine exactly the coset component partition and a linear-in-length additional interval of disconnected symbol-pair graphs relative to Hamming, data absent from ordinary code parameters and known minimum pair distances. The full phase profile, not the minimal pair-weight calculation alone, motivates and justifies the exact statement; no unsupported redundancy-optimality claim is made.
